notes: 📱 Phone: a Knock Knock inbox in the chat. Texts from characters land there with an unread badge, and you can text anyone back. They reply in their own texting style, on their own time: fast if they're free, slower at work, and not until they wake up if they're asleep.
The narrator and off-screen scenes know about recent texts, so people can bring them up in person.

Relationships between characters: everyone in a world now has a closeness score and a description with each other (Krampus starts from their real history). Scenes on and off screen change them, and the narrator plays them that way. See and edit them under 📅 Events → Relationships.
Races: characters and personas can be Human, Thiren (pick the animal), an Intelligent Construct / robot, or anything you type. The AI is told everyone's race; constructs never get cycles.
